summary: Record the requested assistant principal when pairing begin is denied

replay.detail: Existing audit claims are unchanged; no claim replay is required.

schema.detail: No schema changes. Denied pairing begins now record an admitted requested principal when no session or grant identifies one.

rules.detail: No authorization or checkpoint rule changes; admitted assistant principals are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Denied assistant/mcp pairing begins now audit assistant/mcp instead of assistant/chatgpt. Invalid requested IDs retain the assistant/chatgpt fallback. Existing actor and grant principal precedence is preserved.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, configuration changes or re-pairing required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state migration or new rollback restrictions.
